description: Build the entity-aware NLP ingestion pipeline and the three-axis relationship scoring, wire them into Celery workers, and add a one-shot backfill script that fetches real news, runs it through the pipeline, and populates Postgres + Qdrant + Neo4j so the graph is non-empty on first boot. This is the core value of Step 1. Depends on FEAT-001 (stores, config, schema, Celery app). The scoring math and the schema-mapping/type-adapter layer MUST be covered by unit tests that would fail if the logic were reverted.
steps: Create backend/app/pipeline/fetch.py: Python fetchers that reproduce the frontend's live sources. Fetch Google News RSS + publisher RSS (mirror the URLs in lib/news/sources.ts) via httpx + an RSS/XML parser, plus optional Guardian/GNews/NewsData API fetchers keyed off env (mirror lib/news/api-fetcher.ts logic: economicImpactScore heuristic, tag extraction, category/subcategory assignment). Normalize into a Pydantic ArticleIn matching lib/types.ts NewsArticle fields (id, title, summary, source, url, publishedAt, category, subcategory, economicImpactScore, tags). Apply the existing 7-day recency filter and title-similarity dedupe.
Create backend/app/pipeline/clean.py: text normalization (strip HTML, collapse whitespace, lowercasing where appropriate) used before NER and embedding.

Create backend/app/pipeline/ner.py: load spaCy model named by SPACY_MODEL (default en_core_web_sm; keep en_core_web_trf selectable via env for prod). Run NER, then apply a rule-based/EntityRuler layer adding custom finance labels TICKER, COMMODITY, CENTRAL_BANK, ASSET_CLASS, POLICY (seed with obvious lexicons: RBI/Fed/ECB -> CENTRAL_BANK; crude oil/gold/gas -> COMMODITY; Sensex/Nifty/NASDAQ -> ASSET_CLASS/TICKER; etc.). Emit linked entities with a canonicalized name. Map entities to Sector where derivable. Return typed Entity objects.

Create backend/app/pipeline/embeddings.py: generate embeddings via OpenAI EMBEDDING_MODEL (text-embedding-3-large) with batching, retry (tenacity), and a pluggable interface so a fake embedder can be injected in tests. Never log the API key.

Create backend/app/pipeline/scoring.py: implement three-axis relationship scoring between article pairs. (a) semantic: cosine similarity from Qdrant ANN (or direct cosine on stored vectors). (b) entity_overlap: IDF-weighted overlap of linked entities (compute document frequency across the batch; overlap = sum of shared-entity IDF weights normalized to 0-1). (c) causal: an LLM classifier that, only for candidate pairs that pass a semantic/entity screening threshold, asks the model to classify causal relationship + direction (source->target, target->source, or none) with a confidence; pluggable/fakeable for tests. Composite weight = WEIGHT_SEMANTIC*semantic + WEIGHT_ENTITY_OVERLAP*entity_overlap + WEIGHT_CAUSAL*causal, weights read from config (default 0.35/0.25/0.40). Expose pure functions (idf_weights, entity_overlap_score, composite_weight, screen_candidates) that take plain inputs so they are unit-testable without any live service.

Create backend/app/pipeline/schema_map.py: the schema-mapping/type-adapter layer that converts pipeline outputs into (i) Postgres rows, (ii) Qdrant points, (iii) Neo4j node/edge upserts, and (iv) the GraphData/EconomicEdge JSON contract the frontend expects (nodes with id/articleId/label/category/val/color/title/summary/source/economicImpactScore/tags; links with source/target/strength/relationship where strength = composite weight). Keep this layer pure and fully unit-tested.

Create backend/app/pipeline/orchestrator.py: the end-to-end run(articles) that cleans -> NER/link -> embeds -> upserts vectors to Qdrant -> screens candidate pairs -> scores three axes -> computes composite -> persists articles+entities+edges to Postgres and Neo4j (via the FEAT-001 store wrappers and schema_map). Idempotent upserts.
Wire Celery tasks in backend/app/tasks/: ingest_task (fetch -> orchestrator.run) and a celery-beat schedule to run it periodically. Tasks must import cleanly without a live broker.

Create backend/scripts/backfill.py: a one-shot CLI (uv run python -m scripts.backfill or a console entry) that runs fetch -> orchestrator.run against the real datastores and prints a summary (articles, entities, edges, vectors written). Guard OpenAI/LLM usage so that if OPENAI_API_KEY is unset it falls back to a deterministic local embedder + shared-entity heuristic (analogous to the frontend fallback) so backfill still populates a non-empty graph offline.

Create backend/tests/test_scoring.py: unit-test idf_weights (rarer shared entity => higher overlap contribution), entity_overlap_score (0 when no shared entities, higher with more/rarer shared entities, clamped 0-1), composite_weight (verify exact arithmetic for known inputs and that config weight changes propagate), and screen_candidates (pairs below threshold excluded). These must fail if the formulas are reverted.

Create backend/tests/test_schema_map.py: unit-test schema_map producing correct Postgres/Qdrant/Neo4j payload shapes and the GraphData/EconomicEdge JSON contract (strength == composite weight, node color mapping matches the frontend category->color map in lib/news/store.ts).

Create backend/tests/test_orchestrator.py: run orchestrator.run on a small fixture article set with fake embedder + fake LLM + in-memory/mocked stores, asserting expected nodes/edges are upserted and idempotency holds on a second run.
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend && uv run pytest` passes including test_scoring.py, test_schema_map.py, test_orchestrator.py, none of which require live OpenAI/Neo4j/Qdrant/Postgres.
composite_weight uses configurable weights defaulting to 0.35 semantic + 0.25 entity_overlap + 0.40 causal and unit tests assert the exact arithmetic.
The NER layer emits the custom finance labels TICKER/COMMODITY/CENTRAL_BANK/ASSET_CLASS/POLICY on seeded example inputs (asserted in a test).
backfill.py runs against the docker-compose stack and reports a non-zero count of articles, entities, edges, and vectors written; a second run does not duplicate nodes/edges (idempotent).
ruff, ruff format --check, and mypy remain clean.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest -q

docker compose -f /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend/docker-compose.yml up -d neo4j qdrant postgres redis && sleep 20 && cd /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m scripts.backfill && echo 'run twice for idempotency' && uv run python -m scripts.backfill && docker compose -f /projects/sandbox/quant-feed-/backend/docker-compose.yml down
findings:
WHAT WAS BUILT (all under backend/):
- app/pipeline/models.py: typed pipeline data structures. ArticleIn (mirrors frontend NewsArticle fields), LinkedEntity{name,canonical,label,sector}, CausalResult{relationship,direction,confidence}, ScoredEdge{source_article_id,target_article_id,semantic,entity_overlap,causal,direction,weight,relationship,computed_at}. Exports FINANCE_LABELS=('TICKER','COMMODITY','CENTRAL_BANK','ASSET_CLASS','POLICY'), Category/Subcategory/Direction Literals.
- app/pipeline/clean.py: pure text normalization (strip_html, collapse_whitespace, normalize_text, article_text) mirroring the frontend stripHtml.
- app/pipeline/ner.py: spaCy load (SPACY_MODEL, en_core_web_trf selectable via env) + finance EntityRuler layered before ner with overwrite_ents. FINANCE_LEXICON seeds RBI/Fed/ECB->CENTRAL_BANK, crude oil/gold/gas->COMMODITY, Sensex/Nifty/NASDAQ->ASSET_CLASS, repo rate/tariff/monetary policy->POLICY. canonicalize() (case+space fold) is the entity join key; LABEL_TO_SECTOR maps to Sector. extract_entities(title,summary,model_name) returns de-duped LinkedEntity list keeping finance labels + curated spaCy labels (ORG/GPE/PERSON/MONEY/PERCENT/LAW/NORP).
- app/pipeline/embeddings.py: Embedder Protocol (pluggable), cosine_similarity (clamped 0..1), OpenAIEmbedder (batched + tenacity retry, never logs key), LocalHashEmbedder (deterministic md5 feature-hash bag-of-words, L2-normalized). select_embedder(settings) -> OpenAI when OPENAI_API_KEY set else LocalHashEmbedder. Verified offline: related RBI articles cosine 0.671, unrelated 0.0.
- app/pipeline/scoring.py: PURE functions idf_weights (smoothed IDF ln((1+N)/(1+df))+1, rarer=higher, always>0), entity_overlap_score (IDF-weighted Jaccard shared/union mass, 0 when no overlap, clamped 0..1), composite_weight (w_sem*sem + w_ent*ent + w_causal*causal, clamped), screen_candidates (i<j pairs passing semantic OR entity threshold). CausalClassifier Protocol + HeuristicCausalClassifier (offline) + OpenAICausalClassifier (gpt-4o-mini JSON mode). select_causal_classifier(settings) picks by key presence.
- app/pipeline/schema_map.py: PURE adapter layer. CATEGORY_COLORS matches lib/news/store.ts exactly (domestic #22c55e, international #3b82f6, economic #f59e0b, political #ef4444; default falls through to #ef4444). Functions: article_row/entity_row/edge_row (Postgres kwargs), qdrant_point (point_id/vector/payload), neo4j_article_props/neo4j_relates_to (Neo4j upsert kwargs), graph_node/graph_link (frontend EconomicNode/EconomicEdge; link.strength == ScoredEdge.weight), build_graph_data(articles,edges)->{nodes,links}.
- app/pipeline/orchestrator.py: run(articles,*,settings,embedder,causal_classifier,graph_store,vector_store,relational_store,spacy_model,thresholds). Flow: NER -> embed -> ensure_collection + upsert articles/entities/vectors -> build semantic+entity matrices -> screen_candidates -> causal classify survivors -> composite_weight -> persist edges to Postgres+Neo4j. Reorients edge on 'target->source'. GraphStore/VectorStore/RelationalStore are Protocols so fakes inject cleanly. Returns RunResult{articles,entities,edges,vectors,candidates,entities_by_article,scored_edges}.
- app/stores/postgres.py: ADDED PostgresRelationalStore (idempotent upserts by natural key: article id, entity name, source/target pair) implementing the orchestrator RelationalStore protocol. (imports select + Any added.)
- app/tasks/ingest.py: Celery task name 'app.tasks.ingest.ingest_news' (matches the FEAT-001 beat schedule) + run_ingestion() that builds real stores and calls orchestrator.run via the config-driven selectors. Imports cleanly with no live broker/datastores.
- scripts/backfill.py + scripts/__init__.py: `uv run python -m scripts.backfill` one-shot CLI, --limit flag, prints articles/entities/candidates/edges/vectors counts. Offline fallback (local embedder + heuristic causal) when OPENAI_API_KEY unset so the graph is non-empty offline.
- tests/conftest.py: FakeEmbedder, FakeCausalClassifier, InMemoryGraphStore/VectorStore/RelationalStore.
- tests/test_scoring.py (12 tests): exact IDF arithmetic, rarer-entity-higher, overlap 0/weighted-Jaccard/clamp, composite exact default 0.35/0.25/0.40 + config-change propagation + clamp, screen_candidates threshold include/exclude. Would fail if any formula reverted.
- tests/test_schema_map.py (9 tests): category->color == frontend map, row/point/props shapes, graph_node contract (id/articleId/color/val/label truncation), graph_link strength == composite weight, build_graph_data shape.
- tests/test_orchestrator.py (3 tests): populates all stores, idempotency on 2nd run (no dup nodes/edges/entities), empty input.
- tests/test_ner.py (5 tests): pure canonicalize/alias/sector tests unconditional; live-spaCy tests assert TICKER/COMMODITY/CENTRAL_BANK/ASSET_CLASS/POLICY labels + canonicalization/dedupe, guarded with skipif but RAN (en_core_web_sm was downloaded via `uv run python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm`).

VERIFIED (passing, no live services): `uv run ruff check .` clean; `uv run ruff format --check .` clean (31 files); `uv run mypy .` clean (30 files, disallow_untyped_defs); `uv run pytest -q` 34 passed (5 health + 5 ner + 3 orchestrator + 9 schema_map + 12 scoring). Confirmed celery task 'app.tasks.ingest.ingest_news' registers and scripts.backfill imports. Offline embedder produces meaningful cosine similarity.

MOCKED vs LIVE: The end-to-end pipeline is verified with FAKE embedder + fake causal classifier + in-memory stores (test_orchestrator.py) and via the deterministic offline embedder. The LIVE docker-compose datastore round-trip (verification step 2: compose up + alembic upgrade head + python -m scripts.backfill) COULD NOT run in this sandbox: `docker compose` needs the podman API socket which cannot bind (/run/podman missing, no systemctl). Images pull fine and a raw `podman run postgres:16 --tmpfs ... -c fsync=off` DID start and log 'ready to accept connections', but BOTH host->container published-port connectivity AND direct container-IP (10.88.0.8:5432) connectivity fail with netavark/conmon errors ('conmon exited prematurely', 'Cannot assign requested address', 'server closed the connection'). This is the SAME infrastructure limitation FEAT-001 documented (broken podman rootless networking), NOT a defect in the pipeline, compose file, migrations, or scoring. In a normal Docker host, `docker compose up` + `alembic upgrade head` + `python -m scripts.backfill` (twice for idempotency) will populate non-empty Postgres/Qdrant/Neo4j; idempotency is proven in-code by the natural-key upserts and asserted by test_orchestrator.test_orchestrator_is_idempotent.

FOR FEAT-003 (FastAPI read API GET /graph/query + GET /articles/{id}): REUSE app/pipeline/schema_map.build_graph_data(articles: list[ArticleIn], edges: list[ScoredEdge]) -> {'nodes':[...],'links':[...]} to serve the exact GraphData contract the frontend consumes unchanged. Per-node shape from schema_map.graph_node(article) = {id, articleId, label, category, val, color, title, summary, source, economicImpactScore, tags, url}; per-link from schema_map.graph_link(edge) = {source, target, strength(=weight), relationship}. For /articles/{id}, read the Postgres Article row (app/stores/postgres.Article) and map via schema_map.graph_node OR return the raw ArticleIn shape; ScoredEdge/Edge carry semantic/entity_overlap/causal/direction/weight for detail. To read edges back for a graph query, query Postgres Edge (source_article_id/target_article_id/weight/relationship/direction) and rehydrate ScoredEdge, or read Neo4j RELATES_TO. The category->color map lives in schema_map.CATEGORY_COLORS (single source of truth, matches lib/news/store.ts). Build ArticleIn from a Postgres Article row by field-name mapping (published_at is stored as a string in ArticleIn). Frontend proxy branch should be gated on BACKEND_URL with graceful fallback (per context.json).
review_remediation:
REVIEW v1 (2026-08-29) remediation — pipeline/backfill items:
- Issue #4 (offline backfill still needs network, FIXED): added app/pipeline/seed.py with a small deterministic, topically-clustered seed set (RBI/inflation, markets/Fed, oil, trade). backfill.py gained a --seed flag AND auto-falls-back to the seed set when a live fetch returns [] (the truly-offline case), so an offline backfill now yields a non-empty, edge-bearing graph instead of exiting on an empty feed. Docstring narrowed to separate the scoring-offline guarantee from the fetch-offline path. Tests in tests/test_seed_and_persistence.py assert the seed set is deterministic/non-empty and that the orchestrator produces >=1 edge over it offline.
- Issue #8 (node label cosmetic mismatch, FIXED): schema_map._node_label now appends '...' unconditionally (title[:40] + '...'), matching lib/news/store.ts (article.title.substring(0,40) + '...') exactly, so proxied and fallback nodes are byte-identical for the same title. New test test_node_label_appends_ellipsis_unconditionally.
- Note on offline weight consistency (from review Details, not a numbered issue): HeuristicCausalClassifier still returns a constant causal term offline; left as-is for Step 1 (documented behavior) since it is the intended offline degradation and online LLM scoring is opt-in via OPENAI_API_KEY.
